params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Lillia}} abilities apply ''Dream Dust'' to enemies hit, which continually deals {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}} over a short time, and {{tip|heal|heals}} her for the same duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lillia's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply ''Dream Dust'' to enemies hit, which deals{{ft|{{as|5% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|'''total''' magic damage}} over 3 seconds, capped at {{pplevel|70 to 180}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.|{{as|{{fd|0.8{{Recurring|3}}}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.208{{Recurring|3}}}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, capped at {{pplevel|70/6 to 180/6}} per tick against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.}}
params.description2: '''Lillia''' {{tip|heals}} herself for{{ft|{{as|39|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} against large {{tip|monsters}} and {{pplevel|6 + ((90-6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} against {{tip|champions}}|{{as|{{ap|39/6}}|heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15/6}}% AP)}} against large {{tip|monsters}} and {{pplevel|6/6 + ((90/6-6/6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/6}}% AP)}} against {{tip|champions}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds}}over the duration of ''Dream Dust'', reduced to 15% effectiveness for each target afflicted beyond the first. She may only heal against 1 monster at a time.
params.notes:
* ''Dream-Laden Bough'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* {{ais|Lilting Lullaby|Lillia}} application does not apply ''Dream Dust'', but its triggering damage does.
* ''Dream Dust'' is applied even if the target takes no damage from an ability, e.g. by being {{tip|shield|shielded}} or {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, but not when the ability hit is prevented in the first place (e.g. {{tip|spell shield}}).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lillia}} lobs a seed at the target area that rolls forward indefinitely. The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' lobs a seed at the target location that rolls forward indefinitely. The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain while on the ground, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for 3 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds.
params.width: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|120|Lobbed and rolling seed missile width (lobbed seed missile does not collide by itself)}}
params.notes:
* ''Swirlseed's'' origin is determined from '''Lillia's''' position at the start of cast, the rolling direction is determined from '''Lillia's''' position at the end of cast (when the projectile is created, not when the seed starts rolling).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent the seed from detonating thus striking nearby targets.
* {{tip|Projectile|Projectile destroying effects}} will still make the rolling seed detonate upon colliding with them, but not when the initial arcing missile is destroyed.
** If {{cai|Unbreakable|Braum}} blocks the initial projectile, it is destroyed and deals 0 damage to him, as well as not triggering the cone-shaped area of effect.
* The spot at which the seed will collide with terrain is highlighted while it is rolling.
[[File: Swirlseed collision indicator.png|175px|thumb|left|Collision indicator]]

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lillia}} casts a magical lullaby over all enemy {{tip|champions}} affected by ''{{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}}'', making them {{tip|drowsy}} before falling {{tip|asleep}} for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: Damaging {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} targets consumes the debuff to deal additional {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' casts a magical lullaby over all enemy {{tip|champions}} affected by ''{{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}}'', which {{tt|arrives after {{fd|0.3}} seconds|fixed travel time missile}} and renders them {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 10%. After the duration, they fall {{tip|asleep}} for a few seconds.
params.description2: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage that a {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target takes from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} consumes the debuff to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.
params.description3: ''An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} is required to cast this ability. '''Lillia''' can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.''
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent falling {{tip|sleep|asleep}} nor block the wake-up damage.
** The lullaby's {{tip|drowsy}} application will be blocked.
* The additional {{as|magic damage}} dealt is accredited to '''Lillia''' and benefits from her {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.
* ''Lilting Lullaby's'' missile will not hit a target that becomes {{tip|untargetable}} during the cast time or while it is travelling, or is in another realm.
* ''Lilting Lullaby's'' application does not trigger aggro from {{tip|turret|turrets}}, only its triggering damage does.
** {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust's}} persistent damage will still cause '''Lillia''' to trigger turret aggro, unless she casts ''Lilting Lullaby'' right before it runs out.
* {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} will mark targets if ''Lilting Lullaby'' is learned.

blurb.plain: Active: Lillia casts a magical lullaby over all enemy champions affected by Dream-Laden Bough, making them drowsy before falling asleep for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: Damaging sleeping targets consumes the debuff to deal additional magic damage.

description.plain: Active: Lillia casts a magical lullaby over all enemy champions affected by Dream-Laden Bough, which arrives after 0.3 seconds and renders them drowsy for 1.5 seconds, slowing them by 10%. After the duration, they fall asleep for a few seconds.

description2.plain: The next instance of non-persistent damage that a sleeping target takes from champions, large monsters or turrets consumes the debuff to deal additional magic damage.

description3.plain: An enemy champion affected by Dream-Laden Bough is required to cast this ability. Lillia can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.
